pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 e6 5.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 4 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop to g7; plan 1 prepared a d4-d5 break into Black's d5-queen. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in plans 2-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nc6 5.Nf3 cxd4 6.cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into the queen on d5; plan 3 called the e-file open (Black's e7-pawn makes it half-open). Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 harassed the queen with Nc3 while White's pawn stands on c3; plan 4 prepared ...c4 rather than the standard ...cxd4; plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into the queen. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3
pages.notes: Overview described a d4/e4 pawn duo when White has no e-pawn; plan 1 used d5 as White's outpost and gave Black the isolated pawn. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3 e6 6.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported d4 with Nc3, where White's pawn stands; plan 4 pinned a c3-knight that isn't there. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling elsewhere. Plan 3 (Nxd4 to avoid the isolated pawn) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-9 (reviewer: the first draft's 'stable edge' could not be confirmed).

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a d4-e4 route. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...e5
pages.notes: British spelling in the overview. Plan 2 (named d4 as a Black move) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-9 (reviewer: the first draft had ...Nf6 controlling d4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...e6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5 exd5
pages.notes: Overview and plans gave White the isolated pawn; after a later dxc5 it is Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...e6 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a d4-e4 route and mixed a pawn duo with an isolated pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a d4-e4 route. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation, Barmen Defense, Endgame Variation
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-6: plan 3 rerouted a knight via d2 to b3 when it already stands on c3. Rewrote plan 3 around Kd1 (reviewer: the first draft's Be3/Bb5+ do not chase the knight).
